2121407199826346151.en_summary: Ross Gerber agrees with the letter sent to the Nvidia Board outlining minimum acceptable standards for shareholders in this difficult situation, saying it is well said. As long term $NVDA shareholders.
2121407199826346151.zh_summary: Ross Gerber同意致英偉達董事會的信件，概述在此困難情況下股東應獲得的最低可接受標準，並表示說得好。作為長期$NVDA股東。

2121406598094746089.en_summary: Heisenberg notes that $NVDA is now down 6 weeks in a row, marking the second longest weekly losing streak in its 27-year history. The only longer one was 7 consecutive red weeks during the 2008 GFC. Questions if it will tie that next week.
2121406598094746089.zh_summary: Heisenberg指出$NVDA現已連續下跌6週，這是其27年歷史上第二長的週線連跌記錄。唯一更長的是2008年全球金融危機期間的連續7週下跌。質疑下週是否會追平該記錄。

2121405397932122200.en_summary: Ben Woodward notes that NASDAQ $QQQ is showing the look of a Stage 3 top rolling into a Stage 4 decline. Watch for that one "last gasp" rally to trap the dip buyers before the real downtrend begins. Don't try to catch a falling knife; stage analysis > oversold bounces.
2121405397932122200.zh_summary: Ben Woodward指出納斯達克$QQQ呈現第三階段頂部轉入第四階段下跌的形態。注意那一次「最後喘息」反彈，可能在真正下跌趨勢開始前套住抄底者。不要試圖接飛刀；階段分析優於超賣反彈。

2121403597925634194.en_summary: Jonah Lupton outlines a bull case for $APP requiring ecommerce to accelerate meaningfully. Maybe $35 of EPS in 2028 and rerate to 25x EPS which is $875 per share in the next 18-24 months. Unlikely to see $APP at 30x EPS (not even sure back to 25x), which seems unfair vs $KO at 28x and $COST at 48x given $APP's 50% revenue growth and 65% profit margins. Possibly launch CTV product in 2027.
2121403597925634194.zh_summary: Jonah Lupton概述$APP的看多案例，要求電商以有意義的方式加速。也許2028年EPS達35美元，並重新評級至25倍EPS，即未來18-24個月每股875美元。不太可能看到$APP交易於30倍EPS（甚至不確定能否回到25倍），這與$KO的28倍和$COST的48倍相比似乎不公平，因為$APP基本面仍然出色，收入增長50%，利潤率65%。也許2027年推出CTV產品。

ticker_notes.APP: Possible $875 at 25x 2028 EPS if ecommerce accelerates meaningfully, though high multiples appear unlikely.
